pages.text: Use a Dark Steel Ladder for faster climbing. Crouch to hold your position. The steel door and trapdoor follow redstone. Dark Steel Bars and End Steel Bars connect as barriers.

Use Reinforced Obsidian for blast-resistant construction. Match painted walls, stairs, fences and other functional shapes to the room with the $(l:enderio:machines/painting)Painting Machine$(/l). Route a concealed line behind $(l:enderio:conduits/facades)facades$(/l).

A Silent Pressure Plate gives its corresponding redstone output without the click. Paint a Redstone Block or Lever to hide it in a matching build. The painted block still provides power and the painted lever still toggles.
